projects.title: SESTINA
projects.description: Current strongest Canadian Fish bot; exact deal-posterior inference, a linear ask/declaration policy, and guarded determinized search; fitted 55 policy weights by derivative-free optimization against a 31-agent panel, evaluated on 4.3M sealed-holdout games with deal-clustered bootstrap CIs.

projects.title: BarkOff
projects.description:
1v1 barking game which captures 10-second audio window, applies FFT-based spectral analysis, and extracts RMS energy, zero-crossing rate, spectral centroid, pitch contour; aggregated and scored via 400-pt. logistic scale.
**1st Place @ SpaceXAI Build Night with this :sob:

projects.title: Futures + Stocks Research Platform
projects.description: With EE's @ Anduril, built Python-based research system for technical pattern detection, ML-driven setup ranking, and vectorized backtesting; trained XGBoost + LightGBM models on OHLCV data for high-probability trades, optimized detection thresholds with BBO + Optuna, tracked metrics with pytest.

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.description: Always a work in progress... Built with a custom native CMS/editor using React, TypeScript, Next.js/Vinext, Cloudflare Workers, D1, and R2; implemented dynamic content rendering and lossless chunked media uploads.

projects.title: Wake Up
projects.description: Built an iOS-first alarm app in SwiftUI with a modular Swift6 + AlarmKit architecture. Real-time push-up detection using AVFoundation and Apple Vision pose estimation, confidence-filtered shoulder–elbow–wrist geometry, bilateral joint-angle interpolation. A jab at teenage circadian rhythm!

projects.title: SciOly Robot Tour
projects.description: Developed C++ control system on Romi32U4 using encoder feedback and PID-based navigation corrections; implemented calibrated motion primitives + 3D-printed water bottle pusher in SolidWorks. One of the top performing bots nationwide, and the most successful event in my school's history!

projects.title: Vocalis
projects.description: This prototype was all done in 20 hours. Generative-AI powered AAC platform supporting expressive voice synthesis via ElevenLabs, speech prediction + multi-modal context via Gemini, and real-time transcription via Deepgram. **DQ'ed from CAC 2025 for video length (we didn't read the rules).

experience.title: Researcher
experience.description:
Built an ML + MCDA pipeline ranking offshore wind farm siting across Danish waters, fusing 12 fuzzy-normalized GIS criteria spanning wind speed, seabed substrate, shipping lanes, more.
Trained RF, HGB, SVR regressors on 82 offshore sites under 5-fold cross-validation, weighting criteria by AHP pairwise comparisons from 8 domain experts to rank candidate sites

experience.title: Concertmaster
experience.description:
Invited by and performed for the U.S. Secret Service, U.S. congressmen, Richard Nixon Foundation, Yorba Linda Chamber of Commerce, city mayor.
Led 13-musician chamber ensemble in 50+ community concerts for local nursing homes, preschools, libraries, and hospitals.

experience.title: Founder
experience.description:
Built a GenAI-powered augmentative alternative communication (AAC) platform allowing nonverbal and deaf individuals to communicate; 2–5x faster communication rates compared to leading AAC market solutions.
Received $5,000+ funding from Samsung; awards won from Solve for Tomorrow Contest and Diamond Challenge; won 30 gaming chairs for my CS class.

experience.title: Payload Technologies Intern
experience.description:
Worked on edge-AI wildfire classification in autonomous detection drones using PyTorch-trained YOLO + CNN models; for Project WDOS, a drone-based wildfire prevention initiative deploying across four continents.
Authored a 3-volume, 58-page technical report and poster, earning formal project distinction from the California State Senate (presented by Senator Tony Strickland).

experience.title: Researcher
experience.description:
Developed and [published](https://ojs.zefr.org/index.php/intplanet/article/view/26/22) a novel two-step CNN-based pipeline for robust estimations of residential PV capacity.
Delivered invited lectures on CNN theory and project methodology for Prof. Olga Korosteleva's graduate courses within the Department of Mathematics and Statistics.
